Eigen 3.4.0 source availability (MPL-2.0)
This distribution includes unchanged Eigen 3.4.0 code from the original Sherpa-ONNX v1.13.4 dependency chain.
Eigen is primarily licensed under MPL-2.0; the complete license and third-party notices accompany this distribution.
The MPL-covered source is available under MPL-2.0 at:
https://gitlab.com/libeigen/eigen/-/archive/3.4.0/eigen-3.4.0.tar.gz
SHA256: 8586084f71f9bde545ee7fa6d00288b264a2b7ac3607b974e54d13e7162c1c72
A verified complete copy of this unchanged source archive is retained in the accepted release evidence.
No Eigen source modifications are made by Egoist Voice.
The official build workflow provenance is scoped to original source and published asset identity; it is not proof of every compiler input used by the upstream publisher.
Optional LGPL/GPL Eigen sources occur in the complete upstream archive. The Sherpa source inspected uses Eigen/Dense; these optional source licenses are not claimed to govern unrelated Egoist Voice source files.
